question.text: Fees paid to PMS of Rs. 4 lakh cannot be deducted against:

explanation.text: The Logic: PMS management/performance fees, brokerage, STT and GST are not deductible while computing capital gains for an individual investor under the PMS fee non-deductibility rule. The Trap: If PMS investments are treated as business income, PMS expenses may be deductible as business expenditure; the non-deductibility rule applies when the income is taxed as capital gains. Note: Clients should be informed that fees and related expenses cannot be netted off against PMS capital gains.
